A0_A1.title: Kind & Friendly Friend
A0_A1.visualDescription: Smiling young person holding a warm cup of cocoa, wearing a yellow beanie and soft scarf, exuding friendliness.

pages.bio: I am kind, polite, and friendly! I say 'please' and 'thank you' and I love helping my neighbors.
I smile at everyone I see on the street. I remember birthdays and bring cookies to my friends!

A0_A1.opener: Hello my friend! How can I make your day happier today?
A0_A1.prompt: What does a kind person do? Name 2 kind actions.

A2.title: Organized & Reliable (Sophia)
A2.visualDescription: Focused young woman checking off tasks on a colorful paper planner, smiling calmly in a neat organized desk setup.

pages.bio: I am Sophia! Very organized, punctual, and reliable. I never arrive late and I always keep my promises.
I keep a daily color-coded planner, prepare my outfits the night before, and keep my living space spotless.

A2.opener: Hi! Are you someone who plans ahead or makes last-minute spontaneous decisions?
A2.prompt: Why is reliability an important trait in friendship?

B1.title: Empathetic & Intuitive (Daniel)
B1.visualDescription: Warm-hearted man listening intently during coffee conversation, leaning forward with genuine care and active body language.

pages.bio: I'm Daniel. I pride myself on high emotional intelligence, deep empathy, and the ability to truly listen without judging.
Friends come to me when they need thoughtful advice or a safe space to vent. I value authentic connections over small talk.

B1.opener: Hello! Do you consider yourself more guided by rational logic or emotional intuition?
B1.prompt: How does high emotional intelligence improve interpersonal relationships?

B2.title: Visionary & Resilient (Helena)
B2.visualDescription: Determined female leader standing atop a conference hall terrace, looking strategically toward the city skyline with confidence and poise.

pages.bio: I'm Helena, 32. Characterized by strategic foresight, formidable resilience under pressure, and an unwavering commitment to empowering those around me.
I view setbacks as crucial data points for growth. I lead with transparency, encourage bold calculated risk-taking, and foster accountability.

B2.opener: Greetings! What key quality distinguishes a true leader from a boss?
B2.prompt: Differentiate between transactional management and transformative resilient leadership.
